briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and Google Gemini 3 push frontier capabilities amid escalating global race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple advanced models in July 2026, with OpenAI and Google leading capability gains. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny intensifies over safety. Prompt injection and multi-agent risks dominate security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 with major reasoning upgrades. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus while DeepSeek-V3 achieved competitive performance at lower cost. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced major data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 2M units monthly as TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
